title: Contact Us – Connect with AI Experts
description: Reach out to Ameratech.ai for expert AI solutions, automation, and digital transformation services. Contact our team today and accelerate your AI initiatives.
body:
# Contact Us

### We partner with teams to launch accessible experiences, GenAI/LLM solutions, autonomous agents, ML models, and cloud-grade data stacks production-ready, impact-driven, and delivered fast. Tell us your goal, we’ll build it with you.

Do you build custom AI accelerators for our specific needs?

Yes. We start with your use case, tailor the accelerator logic, integrate it with your systems, and deploy it in your environment—so your team can operate it independently over time.

What differentiates Ampera from other AI service providers?

We focus on deployment-ready outcomes. Our teams combine AI expertise and strong data foundations to deliver solutions that run reliably in real business environments—not just in demos.

Can you assist with 508 compliance and VPAT documentation?

Absolutely. We specialize in 508-compliant remediation, ensuring that your digital products are accessible, and we also provide full VPAT support for procurement purposes.

What services do you offer for digital accessibility?

We provide comprehensive accessibility audits, remediation, VPAT creation, and continuous support to ensure compliance with WCAG and Section 508 standards.

How can you help with Generative AI and LLMs?

We leverage Generative AI and LLMs to improve data processing, automate workflows, and enhance decision-making processes across business operations.

Do you provide data engineering services?

Yes, we help businesses build scalable data infrastructure, streamline data pipelines, and enable real-time data processing for better analytics and decision-making.

What information do you need to get started?

A quick overview of your goals, current tools/data sources, and key workflows is enough. We’ll recommend the best approach, a realistic timeline, and the right engagement model.
